title: Eightful
body:
**Eightful** is an 8x8 Minecraft resource pack that reimagines the vanilla textures in a smaller, cleaner pixel style.

Instead of changing Minecraft’s identity, Eightful keeps the familiar colors, shapes, and feel of the original game while reducing the textures to 8x8 resolution. The result is a lightweight pack that feels instantly recognizable, but with a charming low-resolution look.

It is perfect for players who want a simpler version of vanilla Minecraft without losing the classic style of the game.
